Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly focuses on national-scale (Afghanistan) land-use/land-cover (LULC) prediction to 2030 using the Dynamic Land System (DLS) model coupled with linear programming. It implements and quantitatively compares three future scenarios—Business-As-Usual (BAU), Rapid Economic Development (RED), and Environmental Protection (ENP)—and validates LULC projections with quantitative accuracy metrics (overall accuracy = 89%, Kappa = 0.78). The study produces spatially explicit mapped LULC projections for 2030 and uses them as the basis for ecosystem service valuation. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale implementation, primary focus on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy metrics, and mapped LULC outputs. None of the exclusion criteria apply.)
